обращаться.en: A person sees a psychotherapist when they unable to cope with failures in their life.

обсуждать.en: I think we have nothing to discuss here.

обувь.en: There was a box with old shoes in the corner.

обучать.en: The lesson plan is based on the knowledge and skills of the student.

общаться.en: Kolobkov communicated with journalists in a friendly and open way.

общежитие.en: Do you live in an apartment or in a student dormitory?

общежитие.en: It's prohibited to drink alcohol and smoke in the dormitories.

общение.en: Residents of big cities suffer from a lack of human interaction.

общение.en: Friendly communication is important to strengthen relationships in a team.

общение.en: Konstantin Igorevich is a very pleasant person to communicate with.

общество.en: That's not accepted in modern society.

общество.en: Our society is not ready for change.

общий.en: It's good for your development to study music.

общий.en: I have a family and work. Generally, I'm happy with everything.

общительный.en: You are too sociable, it interferes with your work.

объединение.en: Victory is impossible without an alliance of the forces of all participants.

объединение.en: The unification of Germany was an important event in the life of the country.

объединяться.en: Uniting in groups and movements, ecology activists talk about environment protection.
